artifacts.notes: The content-delivery route https://www.vatican.va/content/dam/wss/archive/hist_councils/ii_vatican_council/documents/vat-ii_const_19651207_gaudium-et-spes_lt.html returned a byte-identical 231512-byte response with this SHA-256 on 2026-07-23; the alias route is not duplicated. The response contains the complete numbered Latin body, promulgation material and subscriptions, a legal-vacation notice, and consolidated notes. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.
artifacts.rights_basis: The Vatican portal Legal Notes, reviewed 2026-07-23 at https://www.vatican.va/content/vatican/en/legal-notes.html, limit portal content to personal and non-profit viewing and prohibit collection, reproduction, dissemination, or transfer without prior written authorization from the Dicastery for Communication. No repository redistribution permission was established.

edition.notes: A dated Vatican delivery state of the Latin Constitution. The registered response contains the preliminary note, articles 1-93, the promulgation formula and date, a legal-vacation notice, the Council fathers' subscriptions, and consolidated source notes.
edition.publication: Holy See Latin web presentation of Gaudium et spes, retrieved 2026-07-23

work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Pastoral Constitution on the Church in the Modern World, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 7 December 1965. It comprises numbered articles 1-93; edition records distinguish the Latin Acta witness from dated Vatican web delivery states and translations.
